## [CN]规则
## [EN]Rule

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | While checking badge positions (coordinates, offsets, alignment with the icon), build with `CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED` on. An animated badge (Bounce, Shake, Scale, Breathe, the one-shot types) is drawn away from its laid-out place, so a screenshot taken during the animation gives wrong coordinates (2026-11-17: the HarmonyOS 消息 (Messages) badge looked 13 vp too low because a Bounce animation was still running). With the option on, the badge is drawn exactly where the layout puts it. Turn it off before committing; never commit or ship it on. After the positions are right, check once more with animations on. Label screenshots taken with it: "badge animations off (CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED)". |

## [CN]各平台的编译选项
## [EN]The build option on each platform

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | **iOS** (core, `UIView+CYLBadgeExtention.swift`, `cyl_beginAnimation`): the Swift compilation condition `CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED` on the CYLTabBarController pod target. In the Podfile's `post_install`: `config.build_settings['SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS'] = '$(inherited) CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED' if target.name == 'CYLTabBarController'`, then `pod install` and a clean build. |
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | **Android** (core, `Example-Android/cyltabbar`, `CYLBadge.play` / `playAnimator`): the Gradle property `-PcylBadgeAnimationDisabled=true` (or `cylBadgeAnimationDisabled=true` in `gradle.properties`), read into `BuildConfig.CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED`. The React Native and Flutter components use the iOS and Android host views, so the same options apply to them. |
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | **HarmonyOS** (core, `CrossPlatform/harmonyos-cyltabbar/cyltabbar`, `CYLBadge.ets`, `cylPlay`): `"CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED": true` in `buildOption.arkOptions.buildProfileFields` of `cyltabbar/build-profile.json5`, then rebuild. The generated `cyltabbar/BuildProfile.ets` is ignored by git. |
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | **React Native and Flutter** (assessed 2026-11-17): no own switch is needed. Neither has badge animation code of its own (React Native and Dart only pass `badgeAnimation` on); the badges are drawn by the iOS and Android cores. iOS: the same Podfile `post_install` setting on the CYLTabBarController pod target. Android: inside this repository their Android modules compile the library's sources (`Example-Android/cyltabbar`) themselves, under the `com.cyl.tabbar` namespace, so their `android/build.gradle` (React Native) and `android/build.gradle.kts` (Flutter) now generate the same `BuildConfig.CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED` from `-PcylBadgeAnimationDisabled=true`; without it, CYLBadge.kt did not compile there. Outside the repository they use the published Maven library, built with the option off. |
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | **WeChat Mini Program** (core, `CrossPlatform/wechat-miniprogram-cyltabbar/src/cyl-tab-bar`): its core animates badges itself with CSS keyframes (`cyl_badge_animations.wxss`, the `cyl-badge-<type>` classes), so it has its own switch. A mini program has no compile-time defines, so the switch is a constant in the source: set `CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED = true` in `cyl_debug.js`, run `npm run setup` in `example/` (it copies the component into `miniprogram_npm`), and recompile in WeChat DevTools. `cylBadgeAnimationClass()` then leaves out the animation class of the tabs' badges (`cyl_tab_bar_item_model.js`) and of the plus button's badge (`index.js`). A unit test fails if the constant is committed as `true`. |

## [CN]验证
## [EN]Verification

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | 2026-11-17: **HarmonyOS** built with the option on and run on the Mate 70 Pro emulator (HarmonyOS 6.0.1, API 21, 127.0.0.1:5559), Liquid Glass. Four screenshots in a row of the 消息 "99+" and 我的 "NEW" badges are byte-identical (same MD5), so nothing moves (`assets/badge-debugging-animations-off-harmonyos.png`); with the option off (default) the HAP builds as before. **Android**: `:cyltabbar:compileDebugKotlin` passes with the property on and off, and `BuildConfig` has `CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED = true` / `false`. **React Native and Flutter** (Android, build mirror `/tmp/xpa/cyl`): `:react-native-cyltabbar:compileDebugKotlin` and `:flutter_cyltabbar:compileDebugKotlin` pass with the property on and off; the generated `BuildConfig` has `CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED = true` when on. **WeChat Mini Program**: `npm test` passes (20 tests, one new: off by default, `cyl-badge-bounce` when off, no class when on); `npm run setup` with the switch on copied it into the example, and `npm run check` passes after switching it back off. TODO: the DevTools check (badge classes in the simulator and screenshots with the switch on) did not run, because WeChat DevTools answered "Login is required" (it needs the maintainer's QR code login). **iOS**: `swiftc -parse` passes with and without `-D CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED`; TODO: a full simulator build with the condition on. |

![HarmonyOS badges with animations off](assets/badge-debugging-animations-off-harmonyos.png)

HarmonyOS, Mate 70 Pro emulator, HarmonyOS 6.0.1, API 21 SDK (DevEco Studio 6.0.1), commit on `feat/cross-platform-components` after 136b4f5, 2026-11-17; badge animations off (CYL_BADGE_ANIMATION_DISABLED); four consecutive shots, top to bottom, left to right.
